correctness.rationale: For every real 0<δ≤1/6 select r≥1 with a=1/(3·2^r)<4δ and c∈(a,min(2a,4δ)). Then c<1/3 makes all geometric and reflected atoms v_j lie in the core with only the two endpoint atoms in the outer strips. The original piecewise formulas satisfy the induced-core range restrictions for all points of Y because c<4δ; exact transitions are inward-deterministic at the ends and unbiased at interior vertices, including the δ=1/6 branch equality. The endpoint weights 1/[2(2r+1)] and interior weights 1/(2r+1) satisfy detailed balance and normalization. The chain is irreducible, hence annealed metrically transitive, and both outer strips have positive mass. All source hypotheses thus hold. The rational checker confirms 11 examples, but continuum proof rests on these inequalities and transition identities.

value.rationale: An explicit existence question in a peer-reviewed dynamical-systems study asks for suitable stationary induced-core measures for all nonzero generalized HY perturbations. The initial paper treats examples δ≥1/8, leaving an entire continuous range 0<δ<1/8. A single uniform geometric construction now supplies finite irreducible measures for every positive δ, with exact atom weights and a direct rigorous pathway to the previously conditional arcsine theorem at explicit deterministic initial points. It has real dynamical significance and is not a substitution or textbook example. Only one of the source problem’s two independent families is solved.
